utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is coming along nicely—did they end up getting enough volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, they did—enough folks stepped up to keep it moving. I’ll check the schedule and make sure I know when my shift is.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that’s a relief. Let me know if you hear anything else about the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just point me to the repair drive details and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s in the shared folder under Repair Drive — open the latest doc and check the top section for the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll open the latest doc in Repair Drive and check the top section now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, just to confirm — this repair drive is actually happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yeah, I think so — as long as the timing and drop-off details are nailed down. I just want to make sure the logistics are clear before we count on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, I just wanted to make sure it’s not just an idea. So once the timing and drop-off are set, we’re good?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’d be happy to help out. Just remind me what still needs doing, and I’ll do my best to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — we still need boxes, tape, markers, and a couple folding tables if anyone has them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I can probably bring some boxes, tape, and a few markers. I’ll check whether I can borrow a folding table too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the exact details of the repair drive before I do anything?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m not totally sure I’ve got the exact details right now — I may have missed a change. If you want, I can check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, please check the latest details and let me know before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries at all — it’s going pretty well so far, a few folks have already dropped things off. We could still use a hand if you want to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m in — what do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam—could you bring your cordless drill and a couple screwdrivers, and maybe help me sort the donated parts table when you get here?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I'll bring the cordless drill, a couple screwdrivers, and I'll help sort the donated parts table when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is set up and let you know if it moves.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — that’d be really helpful. Please let me know if it shifts so I can plan around the school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll keep watch and let you know right away if it moves.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout already. If you want, I can pass along the details to anyone nearby.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess — thank you! I’m happy to spread the word too, so anyone nearby can come by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Lovely — the more neighbors who know, the better. I’ll keep mentioning it, and maybe we’ll get a few more folks to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Rey, what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still checking a few things, but I know the front gate and the hall light need attention.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — do you want me to help with the gate or the hall light?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you keeping everyone in the loop. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan to folks and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’ve got the repair drive list organized and I’m ready to start coordinating volunteers. Let’s make sure we cover the urgent fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I can help where it’s manageable, but I may need to keep things low-key today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Uli — we’ll keep it low-key and only take on the manageable pieces. I’ll send you the simplest tasks first so you can jump in comfortably.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely — folks are dropping off tools, paint, and all sorts of useful stuff.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that sounds right to me. I’ll stop by with what I can and keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Eli — every little bit helps, and I’ll make sure folks know you’re coming by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ve been telling folks we’re still on for Saturday morning, and I’ll keep repeating that plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — I’ll spread the word and make sure everyone knows Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive, Uli. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I still need to sort the donation list and label the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take the donation list and get the box labels started.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring your toolbox and meet me by the repair drive at the side gate? I’ll keep an eye on the location and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll bring my toolbox and head to the side gate.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—want me to spread the word to a few neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please—if you can, share it with a few neighbors and let them know I’m checking the details first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll let a few neighbors know and tell them you’re still confirming the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I must've missed the update, what do we still need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We still need a few donated tools and someone to help sort the drop-off table. If you can swing by for an hour, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can swing by for an hour and help sort the drop-off table. What time should I come?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard anything new yet, Gus, but I can check around when I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. If you hear anything about the repair drive, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, Gus — I’ll keep an ear out and tell you if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you bring the toolbox and help sort the donated parts? I’ll handle the list and labels.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the toolbox and help sort the donated parts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a little worried about the timing and what needs to be brought. Do we know where the repair drive is happening and what they’re accepting?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m not sure yet, but I’ll check the location and the list of accepted items. If you want, I can message the organizer now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please do—that would help a lot. I’d feel better once we know the place, the time, and exactly what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I’ll pass the word around right away and make sure folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep track of the supplies and make sure we have what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll go door to door and post a note on the block board too. We’ll get the whole neighborhood involved.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye — I’m still trying to pin that down, but I’ll check and let you know as soon as I have the time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — just send it over when you know, and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Nell — I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’m happy to help organize the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thank you, Rosa — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so that’s really helpful. What should I do first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Start by telling me which repairs you’ve noticed, and I’ll add them to the list. If you can, include the address and anything urgent so we can sort priorities quickly.
